verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a game engine, since engines can ship telemetry or analytics services whose data a buyer would want to control. The pack has no evidence of Bevy controls for retaining or deleting data. The Scene system's create/save/load of ECS worlds is ordinary app-data persistence, not a privacy retention control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
